object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Start mellon-mcp over stdio on a clone. Initialize, then call list_documents and compare_document, and export_document with a stand-in typesetter. While the session is open, list the server process's sockets (psutil.Process(pid).net_connections('all'), or netstat -ano filtered by PID). Expected: the process has no TCP socket in LISTEN state and no bound UDP socket.
